tasks.title: Freeze product scope
completion_criteria: Recorded replay and analyst prioritization; units and supported claims documented.
tasks.evidence_note: Scope, units (simulation currency units, relative hours) and supported claims documented in README and contract.

tasks.title: Acquire canonical PaySim and provenance
completion_criteria: Original version-2 archive, publisher licence/warning and SHA-256 saved.

tasks.title: Initial full-file profile
completion_criteria: Schema, row/type/label/step counts and same-role account recurrence reproduced.

tasks.title: Complete data-quality checks
completion_criteria: Non-finite values and duplicate semantics investigated with explicit rejection policy.
tasks.evidence_note: 0 NaN/inf/negative/unparseable values; 0 exact or label-conflicting duplicates; no rows removed; serving rejection policy recorded.

tasks.title: Profile recipient-history coverage
completion_criteria: Strict earlier-step coverage measured by split, transaction type and class; sender limitations retained.
tasks.evidence_note: Strict earlier-step recipient coverage by partition x type x class; sender limitation retained (0.09-0.26%).

tasks.title: Freeze feature contract and chronological protocol
completion_criteria: All balances/derivatives, labels, policy flags and raw IDs excluded; exact cutoffs and warm-up rule recorded.
tasks.evidence_note: split-v1 and features-v1 frozen 2026-11-09; cutoffs 1-281/282-355/356-743 unchanged; full prior warm-up rule.

tasks.title: Implement meaningful baselines
completion_criteria: All-negative, native policy, amount/type rule, seeded daily random ranking and logistic regression reported.
tasks.evidence_note: All five baselines reported on validation; test not accessed.

tasks.title: Implement capacity and artifact evaluation
completion_criteria: AP, daily top-K, false alerts per 1000, per-time/type, mixed-hour and prevalence references tested on development.
tasks.evidence_note: AP, daily top-K with pro-rated partial days, false alerts/1000, per-type/day, mixed-hour and prevalence references.

tasks.title: Build eligible history features
completion_criteria: Only supported recipient/prior-step features; no same-hour or future influence; measured ablations.
tasks.evidence_note: Recipient-history features only; DuckDB table equals reference implementation; ablation ladder measured.

tasks.title: Compare one CPU booster
completion_criteria: Same population and capacity; limited model search; validation evidence determines choice.
tasks.evidence_note: 12 candidates (8 LR, 4 booster) on identical population/capacity; selected on validation AP.

tasks.title: Freeze champion, policy and final evaluation
completion_criteria: Versions pinned; final test report run once after selection; uncertainty/limitations reported.
tasks.evidence_note: champion-v1 frozen with artifact hash; refit reproduced validation AP exactly; test run once with day-block bootstrap.

tasks.title: Define application schema and typed API
completion_criteria: Truth isolated; model vector/version stored; server owns history features and evidence cutoffs.
tasks.evidence_note: Truth in a separate schema the serving role cannot read; score rows store model/feature/policy versions and the score-time vector; server computes history and evidence cutoffs; client labels/balances/aggregates/cutoffs rejected (422).

tasks.title: Implement replay and history checkpoint recovery
completion_criteria: Mid-hour interruption matches uninterrupted run; day-finalization and event writes idempotent.
tasks.evidence_note: Crash mid-step 357 (real data) left 0 partial scores; resumed run identical to uninterrupted (74,152 scores, 42 alerts, 42 cases); re-run and finalization idempotent.

tasks.title: Verify serving and offline feature consistency
completion_criteria: Fixture scores match; illegal inputs and label access fail explicitly.
tasks.evidence_note: 74,152/74,152 replay scores exactly equal offline; 0 feature mismatches; API /score equals persisted replay score and feature hash; illegal inputs 422; serving role denied on truth.

tasks.title: Build analyst queue and case evidence
completion_criteria: Missing histories honest; scoring time and case evidence time separated.
tasks.evidence_note: Explicit missing-history states; scoring step and case evidence cutoff stored and shown separately; score-time vs review-time records split; replay queues match offline test per day (12/44/57).

tasks.title: Build human disposition and audit flow
completion_criteria: Authenticated human actions, optimistic update versions, and append-only audit entries.
tasks.evidence_note: Bearer-token demo authentication (hashed); optimistic versions (stale -> 409, concurrent race -> one winner); append-only audit per transition/note; disposition required to close.

tasks.title: Run end-to-end and performance checks
completion_criteria: Replay-to-review fixture passes; hardware, batch time and API latency measured.
tasks.evidence_note: Replay-to-review fixture passes; hardware recorded; batch scoring 1.25M rows in ~6 s; replay ~2,000 rows/s; API p50/p95 17-35/38-62 ms sequential, /score 51-66 req/s at concurrency 4. Fresh setup reproduced every report including the byte-identical model artifact. Dependency T21 remains partial.

tasks.title: Publish reproducible portfolio release
completion_criteria: Readme, setup, data/model cards, evaluation, architecture and recorded demo verified.
tasks.evidence_note: Captioned 4 min 40 s recording of the actual local UI, live local assistant and human review/audit flow. 101 tests pass. Full video decode checked; source holdout/freeze report hashes unchanged. Fresh holdout stays 10/12 with documented limitations.

tasks.title: Author compact local-assistant development and holdout cases
completion_criteria: Approximately 20 authored evidence tasks split into development/holdout groups; numeric, citation and failure checks defined.
tasks.evidence_note: 20 authored cases (8 dev / 12 holdout) across normal, missing history, arithmetic, wrong ID, future data, hidden label, adversarial note, tool failure, sender history; deterministic checks in src/fraudinv/assistant_eval.py.

tasks.title: Implement bounded assistant with local free inference
completion_criteria: Actual local model inference and typed evidence tools work; no paid API dependency; case/run/cutoff boundaries enforced.
tasks.evidence_note: qwen3:4b via local Ollama (Vulkan); 5 read-only typed tools bound to case/cutoff; read-only DB session without truth access; deterministic guard; no paid API. eve not used: eve@1.0.0-rc.7 requires Node >= 24 (installed 22.9.0).

tasks.title: Evaluate local assistant and failure handling
completion_criteria: Local inference measured; numeric facts/citations verified on holdout; no observed hidden-label/future-data access or unauthorized writes; template fallback is not counted as AI completion.
tasks.evidence_note: v1 holdout 10/12 exposed citation/quote/cutoff gaps; fixed and re-evaluated on a new unseen v2 holdout (run once): 10/12, 0 writes, 0 label claims, 0 invalid refs in any form, 0 quoted note text, cutoff stated on every assistant answer. Failures: guard false positive on a number from the question (template fallback, counted as failure) and a rubric false negative on a correct label refusal.

tasks.title: Run independent ULB benchmark
completion_criteria: Separate data/schema/model and temporal report; no merged rows or unsupported transfer claim.

tasks.title: Verify local-AI feasibility early
completion_criteria: Small local model runs without a paid service; summary and typed tool test measured for RAM, latency and correctness; runtime compatibility verified.
tasks.evidence_note: Local inference verified end to end (Ollama native API; OpenAI-compatible route verified Day 1). eve incompatibility documented (Node >= 24); Python loop adopted as smallest free alternative.

sprint_estimate_hours.scope: focused MVP including bounded local assistant; not the entire original roadmap
